$comment: Scheme data files under src/shelfmark/schemes/, one entry per scheme. Each loads from its file with `shelfmark scheme compile <file>`; none is compiled into the binary (plan R5). A `distribution: fetch` entry is built locally from its source and never committed.

schemes.name: acm-ccs
schemes.title: ACM Computing Classification System
schemes.license: ACM, Inc.: educational and research use; not redistributable, so not bundled

schemes.name: eurovoc
schemes.title: EuroVoc (multilingual thesaurus of the EU Publications Office)
schemes.license: EU reuse terms stated inconsistently (Commission reuse notice in dataset metadata, CC0 in a third-party registry); not bundled, built from the Publications Office download

schemes.name: ipc

schemes.attribution: International Patent Classification (IPC), World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), edition 20260101. Licensed CC BY 4.0. Reformatted by shelfmark; not endorsed by WIPO.
